item.title: Dear residence. Please be advised for your own safety. There was an attempted stabbing mistaken identity that took place on 09/09/26 at 11:43pm a member of public was randomly attacked in his car. Parked in Semley gate car park.Four black males early 20s 30s on lime higher bikes surrounded the victims vehicle and smashed his driver side window with a large zombie knife. Trying to inflict harm on member of public Before the perpetrators fled the scene the black male perpetrators one of them shouted to his friend it's not him wrong person.The victim was ambushed. Which is also concerning because there is two residents who park similar Mercedes Benz silver car at that location.The perpetrators were targeting,premeditated on a silver Mercedes-Benz description. The perpetrators are after somebody who drives a silver Mercedes-Benz. They are targeting that description of a vehicle. therefore they might have got the wrong vehicle and it was intended for another resident so beware.This was an attack of mistaken identity these four black males need to be taken off our streets. These individuals pose a risk to members of public. the local authority need to reassure residents they are keeping them safe. The police need to do more patrols and install CCTV for safety and security measures for residents and members of public. Lack of policing,no enforcement in the area. Lack of CCTV on the Trowbridge estate. Saving money is more important than residence safety and security. If anybody see anything please report to the Hackney council or police. Sergeant Terry Hughes Dedicated Ward Officer Luke Davidson Inspector Mohammed Uddin HackneyWick@contact.metengage.co.uk Harps Dhaliwal works as an Anti-SocialBehaviour Incompetent. Wayne Hylton, is currently a ASB and Estate Safety Manager at London Borough Of Hackney Council. Who does nothing for residence safety and security. Incompetent Emergency vs Non-Emergency Emergency: Call 999 if life is in danger, someone is injured, or a crime is happening right now. Non-Emergency Police: Call 101 or report online via the Met Police. Hackney Council Contacts 24-hour ASB Service: Call 020 8356 3310 (press option 1). Email: asb.housing@hackney.gov.uk Noise Nuisance (Mon–Fri, 9am–5pm): 020 8356 3000; (Out of hours): 020 8356 4455. In Person: Hackney Service Centre, 1 Hillman Street, E8 1DY. Crime reference number: 01/8045148/26, 10th September
